title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS Horrible product even worse customer service
text: AVOID AT ALL COSTS Horrible product even worse customer service. Horrible customer service! 50 attempts to contact and they refuse to answer! SCAM I have had both of my choppers break in the same area. The front area is weak and does not support pressure like it should under normal usage. I have tried to reach customer service for MONTHS!  Zero response. Avoid this item.
